topic: tell whether a car battery needs to be replaced
core_question: How do I know if my car's battery is failing and needs replacing? (secondary: How do I fix my laptop's battery percentage reading that seems wrong?)
answer_summary: Get the battery load-tested (many auto parts stores do this free) to check its voltage and cranking capacity, replacing it if it fails the test.; after the topic shift: Let the laptop battery drain fully until it shuts off, then charge it uninterrupted to 100% to recalibrate the reported percentage.
persona: tired and blunt; texting quickly with typos here and there
